products.name: Tineco Floor One S7 Stretch Steam Cordless Wet Dry Vacuum Steam Mop All-in-One, 320℉ HyperSteam, 180° Lay-Flat, Anti-Tangle Design, FlashDry Self-Cleaning, Up to 75 Min Runtime
specs: Please note: The initial steam preparation takes around 60s. For subsequent uses, this time reduces to about 45s. This waiting period is normal and not a product malfunction. Preparation time may vary depending on the usage environment and user habits, the actual time shall prevail.

320℉ HyperSteam Technology: Heats steam up to 320℉, ensuring the outlet temp does not fall below 210℉. Effectively dissolves stubborn grease and stains, from dried waste and sticky residue to heavy oil stains, etc.
180° Lay-Flat Design: Effortlessly reaches low areas, enabling the cleaning of hidden dust at heights as low as 5.1 inch.
DualBlock Anti-Tangle Design: Efficiently manages hair and pet fur, preventing tangles with ease.
FlashDry Self-cleaning System: 2min Self-cleaning & 5min Flash Drying with 185℉ Air for thorough cleaning.
Ultra-long runtime: Up to 75* min runtime allows for whole-house cleaning on a single charge (*In lay-flat position at any mode). Up to 30min Runtime (Steam Mode).
In order to maintain the stability, please follow the instructions and operation video to clean the filter and HEPA once a month.
